alt: 大人不斷拖乾地板，漏水接頭卻繼續把水灑回地上；同伴指著仍未關閉的供水閥，旁邊水桶已裝滿。
scene_prompt: Modern utility room. Adult keeps mopping up puddles under leaking water pipe, clearing a small dry patch, but water steadily sprays downward from visibly loose pipe joint and refills puddle. A second adult points toward the supply shutoff valve above, still left open and untouched, showing root cause unaddressed. Main person busy only treating floor, already full bucket of wrung-out mop water beside them. Small soft-edged earlier inset shows same puddle being cleared, later large main scene shows it has returned. Clear temporary symptom relief without solving source. Water obeys gravity, pipe joint water leak plausible, mop touches wet floor, bucket stable, two arms and correct hands, sensible boots and safe room. 3:2 landscape graphite watercolor colored pencil ivory paper, no text labels letters numbers brands logos watermarks.
